meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并校验计算流体仿真,让模拟稳定可靠、安全续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用计算流体仿真做科研数值模拟,需要确认设置准确并安全重启任务
copy.tagline_en: Set up and validate fluid-flow simulations for stable, safe runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run computational fluid dynamics simulations and need sound setup and safe restarts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 FluidSim 帮你写并运行流体仿真代码:选择求解器、配置参数、启动模拟,再画图和分析输出结果。
howto.when: 当你提到流体仿真、Navier-Stokes、湍流等关键词,或要求做求解器选择与参数审查时触发接管。

say.text: 用 ns2d 求解器跑一次 256×256 的二维湍流模拟,画出涡量场。
say.note: 会生成参数配置、启动模拟并输出涡量图。

say.text: 把 nu_2 改成 1e-4,开启 USE_CFL,重跑并对比能量谱。
say.note: 会改参数重跑并绘制一维能量谱。

say.text: 用 mpirun -np 8 跑 3D 512 网格,并检查重启是否兼容。
say.note: 会给出 MPI 命令并检查重启兼容性。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses FluidSim's Python framework to write and run CFD simulations: pick a solver, set parameters, start the run, then plot and analyze the output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention fluid simulation, Navier-Stokes or turbulence, or ask for solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics or restart checks.

say_en.text: Run a 256x256 2D turbulence case with the ns2d solver and plot vorticity.
say_en.note: Sets up params, runs it, and plots vorticity.

say_en.text: Change nu_2 to 1e-4, enable USE_CFL, rerun and compare energy spectra.
say_en.note: Reruns with new params and plots 1D spectra.

say_en.text: Run a 3D 512-cubed case with mpirun -np 8 and check restart compatibility.
say_en.note: Gives the MPI command and checks restart compatibility.
